prompt: Implement a safe production release source freshness repair. Existing scripts/version-and-commit.rs sync_with_remote and push retry rebase can move actual source away from original GitHub main run head; downstream resolve-package-release.mjs correctly rejects tags not equal to run head or immediate child, and GITHUB_TOKEN suppresses release event. Do not broaden resolver ancestry or alter release.yml events/floors/caller/projection. Add small readable Node source freshness guard called only for actual GitHub Actions release jobs before initial sync and each push retry. Independently require actual main release event/caller/job/repository/ref/head and exact remote main, refuse newly rebased source. Permit retry only unchanged original main or identical already-pushed release child; never pull/rebase in guarded CI. General non-CI version CLI behavior remains. Add independent physical Git and refusal controls and preserve complete original resolver failing observation. No compiler/native runs, no publication. Implement full fix, use testable explicit dependencies and source guards.
